<header>CHARAKA-SAMHITĀ.</header>

# CHARAKA-SAMHITĀ.

---

## THE PLACE OF APHORISMS.

### LESSON I.

So then we will explain the lesson about **Longevity**.*<sup>1</sup>

Oil subjugates <unclear>wind</unclear>, Ghee subjugates bile.†

*(Here is a verse containing a summary.)*

<image-desc size="small" type="decorative" significance="low">A divider.</image-desc>

---

* Longevity is *Ayu* in the original.—T.

† Bile is *pitta*.—T.

<note>12</note>

<margin>a. Vide note b in p. 8.</margin>

<vocab>Ayu, pitta, wind, bile</vocab>

Honey subjugates phlegm when it is constantly used in proper measure.

* A footnote with no rule above it.—T.
